reviewMethod: Poppler at 150 DPI; all 8 page renders viewed at native page proportions
brandingObservations: All 4 first pages show the approved institutional image with the square white background of the source artwork.
EBD uses a 20 mm square; calendar uses a 22 mm square. No crop, stretching, header collision, or pixel substitution was observed.
Continuation pages preserve the existing generator behavior: content and footer, without a repeated institutional header.

existingNonBrandingIssues.issue: The trophy emoji is rendered as unsupported glyphs in the first row of the class ranking.
existingNonBrandingIssues.suggestedFix: Remove the trophy from the PDF or replace it with a drawn shape or a compatible embedded font. Preserve class order, calculations, and names.

scopeLimits: This certifies the institutional image in the 4 generators with fictitious data; it is not a certification of every possible input or report layout.
The PDF image is checked in RGB pixel space. The test does not certify print-shop color management or ICC interpretation in external PDF viewers.
The calendar fixture uses short titles. Its existing first-line-only title rendering is not altered or certified for arbitrary long text.
Each document is approximately 4.9 MB because the existing jsPDF image pipeline embeds the 1280 RGB raster without compression.
